request.scriptPreLabel: Runs before the request is sent

scriptDocs.preIntro: JavaScript runs immediately before the HTTP request is sent. Your code is executed as a function with a single argument: pm.
scriptDocs.preNote: The request is already fully resolved (URL, method, headers, including environment variables). Changing pm.request in the script does not change what is sent over the network—edit the request in the UI or use pm.environment.set to persist values on the active environment.
scriptDocs.postIntro: JavaScript runs after the response is received. pm.response holds the HTTP result; pm.environment behaves the same as in the pre-request script.
scriptDocs.postNote: pm.response.json() calls JSON.parse on the body and throws if the body is not valid JSON.
scriptDocs.consoleIntro: Use pm.console.log, .info, .warn, and .error to print messages to the Response → Console tab.
scriptDocs.consoleCompletionHint: Prints to the Response → Console tab.

preApi.desc: Returns the value for key in the active environment, or an empty string if it is missing.

Read-only snapshot: { url, method, headers }. Mutating this object does not change the outgoing HTTP request.

postApi.desc: Returns the value for key in the active environment, or an empty string if it is missing.
Creates or updates a variable on the active environment. An environment must be selected in the UI.
Response headers as a plain object.
Parses the body as JSON. Throws if the body is not valid JSON.
Same resolved request snapshot as before the request was sent.
